name: Darnukas
backstory: Child of Nakus and Darnus; grew up around walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn... in Salthos Cruzados, and knows something of Crossing Toll Dispute.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Forliamus Log Crossing War their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Forliamus Log Crossing War as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: writes down every claim brought before the house same as her mother taught her, but reads back further into the old files than anyone thinks to ask her to

arc.premise: Darnukas has taken to comparing every version of the old Forliamus Log Crossing War he's ever heard - guardhouse, temple, and clerk's ledger alike - hoping to find the one detail all three tellings actually agree on.
